_comment: Template — copy to ~/.copilot/settings.json and merge, it is not symlinked. Copilot's own CLI manages ~/.copilot/config.json (state: firstLaunchAt, installedPlugins); this file is the user-settings layer and is where model/allowedUrls/permissions go.
//: Permission keys. Copilot prompts for anything not listed, so start closed and widen. Verified against copilot CLI 1.0.82: --allow-tool / --deny-tool / --allow-url / --deny-url exist and are accepted. Note: -p/--prompt mode did NOT enforce deniedTools or --deny-tool on a local .env read in testing, so treat these as a guardrail for interactive use, not a hard boundary. Keep secrets out of the working tree and inject per-command via `op run --env-file=.env -- copilot`.
